title: How to reactivate your account
description: If you have deactivated your account, and it’s been less than 30 days, follow the steps below to reactivate your account.

toc.title: When can I use the email address/username from my deactivated account?
I’m trying to reactivate my account but I do not remember my password:

runs: via x.com, or open your >x< for iOS or Android app.
Before you sign in, you’ll see a notice asking you to confirm if you want to reactivate your account.
If you choose to reactivate, you’ll be redirected to your Home timeline. Please note that posts, followers, likes, etc., may take a while to fully restore.
When can I use the email address/username from my deactivated account?

The username and email address on a deactivated account are available for use on another account 30 days after the account was deactivated. Within those 30 days, the information remains tied to the deactivated account to allow for reactivation.
